alternatives.option: Keep process.exit and add an unref'd watchdog
alternatives.reason_rejected: still races the native thread pool; the abort is in the runtime's destructor, not in Node

context: CLI lane applied all 7 confirmed review findings on feat/cli-2.17: exit-134 blocker fixed (process.exitCode + drain, red-on-revert test with a real model cache), unknown flags/positional payloads/dangling value flags rejected with exit 2, envelope carries absolute project_root/store_dir, requires_mode in capabilities, doc counts corrected (15 handlers, 24+7 hidden), embedder offline upgrade-only.
rationale: Reproduced 3/3 by two independent refuters and by the lane; the fix measured 5/5 exit 0 in ~0.3 s with a real cache and is also safer (an in-flight async embedding write is no longer truncated). Regression guard: a test that symlinks the real ~87 MB model cache and is skipped when absent, proven red when dist was patched back to process.exit.
summary: CLI exits by setting process.exitCode and letting the event loop drain (sqlite handle and drain timer closed in finally) instead of calling process.exit — the latter raced onnxruntime-node's thread pool and aborted with SIGABRT (exit 134) on every successful run with a cached embedding model
